[[File:Summer Star.png|thumb]]

The '''Summer Star''' is a new obtainable item introduced in the [[Update_Log#|Summer]] update which can be bought for 150 Pearls from the Navi NPC next to spawn!

==Information==
* Inside the '''Summer Star''', you can discover 4 new exclusive units and 13 different Summer themed skins!
* If you haven't received a {{Rarity|Mythic}} after 400 '''Summer Stars''', you will get one guaranteed!
* Roger is not obtainable through {{Rarity|Mythic}} pity.
* The 4 exclusive units are Harribu, Kizume, Avdo, and secret unit Roger
